packageRules.description: wasm-pack 0.14.0 on npm references drager/wasm-pack (a fork) instead of wasm-bindgen/wasm-pack in its binary.js, causing a 404 when downloading the binary. Pin until fixed. See https://github.com/wasm-bindgen/wasm-pack/issues/1577
stacker 0.1.24+ requires windows-sys >=0.60 which uses windows-link instead of windows-targets, breaking the x86_64-pc-windows-gnu (MinGW) build. Pin until upstream fixes this.

From 3.8.0 on, napi artifacts can wedge on Windows runners: a failed lock cleanup leaves the reconciliation lock owned by the live process, and it is never reclaimed. Pin until this is fixed upstream.
this restriction should not be updated by renovate.
Majors are only updated manually: @types/node must match the engines.node floor, typescript and vite when their tooling follows, react and react-dom for the REPL
